title: The One-Person Ad Factory
pitch: Feed a plain product photo through the industrial prompt-template library to get polished, on-brand lifestyle shots, then hand those images straight into the agentic video production system to script, animate, and edit them into a finished ad. A solo e-commerce seller gets a photographer, art director, and video editor's output for the price of a couple of API calls, with a new video ready before lunch.
why_now: Short-form video ads are the highest-converting placement on every ad platform right now, but small sellers can't afford a photo shoot and an editor — this combo replaces both for a few dollars per video.
